key_finding.title: Evidence component tool instructions cause S02 execution-mode degeneration
key_finding.detail: In no-tool vLLM environment, configs containing the evidence component (with ralph/ego-browser instructions) show 38% S02 degeneration rate (10/26 cells). The model enters 'execution mode' (attempting to run shell commands or echoing tool calls) instead of 'generation mode' (writing the research report). Configs WITHOUT evidence component show 0% degeneration (16/16 valid). This is a protocol-environment interaction effect, not a component content effect.
key_finding.implication: The fullloop multi-stage pipeline requires either (a) tool access for the evidence stage, or (b) removal of tool-use instructions from the evidence component when running in text-only mode. The current R4 frozen prompts were designed for an agent environment with tools; direct transfer to no-tool vLLM introduces this instability.

next_steps: For publication-grade results: re-run degenerate cells with modified evidence prompt (tool instructions replaced with 'use public knowledge' fallback)
OR: accept degeneration as a valid experimental finding about protocol-environment mismatch
Arena hetero-judge for valid cells (when arena available)
